テキスト cha 471: Born Shiyo 757, May 27. Height 155cm (as of Shiyo 788).\nFrom the Arata settlement; lives in Motoki-cho. Short, fat, ugly, shy, indecisive. He apparently has an older twin, identical in looks, opposite in nature, whom he wished to resemble. That failed; blundering before Mifuyu, he despairs further. Seeing his self-contempt, Mifuyu found him like her and liked him for their close values and for seeing past looks to her heart. Why he came to Motoki-cho is unknown.

As he goes back and forth with Mifuyu Niimura, who has barged into his home, he gradually becomes able to respond calmly, and Mifuyu Niimura falls head over heels for him for his straightforward, earnest character and because he seems someone to rely on when it counts. He seems to have noticed this too; the day after they met he proposed, and was accepted.

To Mifuyu Niimura, torn over whether to take in an adopted child from the Kogori family, he gives his opinion from Akane Kogori's point of view. He suggests that, for a stronger bond and trust between the two of them, it might be better to take in the child. As a result, rather than refusing right away, Mifuyu Niimura decides to talk it over many times and search for an answer they can both accept.

He climbed a tree to get the balloon Natsumi Kogori had let fly, and fell. He twisted his body because Natsumi Kogori was about to be caught beneath him, but unluckily that caused his neck to be pierced by a fence, and he died. One view also holds that at that moment a roar rang out from somewhere, which startled him and made his hand slip.
According to Kotaro Niimura, he lived in the Arata settlement until middle school. But after a severe leg injury while hunting, he lost confidence in living in the settlement and apparently left.

He appears in the dream of Natsumi Kogori, unconscious and near death. There he makes 2 promises with her: not to blame Kotaro Niimura, and to stay by Haruka Niimura's side always. On the first, he says Kotaro's actions could not be helped, and that Kotaro would choose his own death over having the truth known. That is, she must pursue the truth no further, or it will rob the rest of her life of happiness.

シナリオ名: メガミゴロシミナゴロシ
テキスト cha 471: He should have died, but he has come back to life as a divine messenger. In the Shiyo 800 incident he kills Mifuyu Niimura, but as a divine messenger she turns out incomplete. His aim is to gather the living first and second generations and the dead first and second generations.

In middle school, to end the bullying of Sakura Niimura, he uses Droga with his own body as the test subject. But unable to hold down the elation that is Droga's side effect, he goes wild and is badly hurt. Because of that injury and his guilt toward Sakura Niimura, he leaves the Arata settlement for Motoki-cho as soon as he finishes middle school.

Put to work by Shigatsu Youka, he appears in order to kidnap Chigaya Niimura. With Sakura Niimura, he tries to take Chigaya to Shigatsu Youka. The wound that should have pierced his neck when he died is gone.

シナリオ名: 黙示録のラッパ吹き～虚虚実実～
テキスト cha 471: He knocks Chigaya Niimura out and takes her to the underground storeroom. First he gives her falsificaso to cancel out her third-generation traits, then uses Droga to make her first generation. By touching the Verde mummy, Chigaya became fourth generation: in other words, an embryo of Shigatsu Youka.

シナリオ名: 黙示録のラッパ吹き～虚虚実実～
テキスト cha 471: With Chigaya Niimura, he corners Erina Goto and tries to take her to Shigatsu Youka as a hostage.
